system.description: You become nearly impossible to stop or harm. Anyone trying to block or restrain you fails automatically unless they have Potence equal to your Fortitude, in which case a normal Physical Challenge decides whether you are forced to stop. Whenever damage is inflicted on you, win a Simple Test to ignore aggravated damage entirely (tie converts it to lethal), or win or tie to ignore lethal damage entirely; all bashing damage is ignored outright. You cannot walk through walls or deliberately crush people by walking into them, and two Juggernaut users meeting each other negate the effect against one another.
